info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bill Pay Switches API
info.description: The Bill Pay Switches API allows businesses to manage bill payment options for their customers efficiently. This endpoint retrieves the current settings for bill pay switches associated with a specific customer. Common use cases include updating customer preferences or integrating with financial management tools to provide real-time payment processing capabilities. Developers can leverage this API to enhance customer experience by offering tailored bill payment options based on their individual settings.

get.summary: Retrieve Bill Pay Switches for a Customer
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current state of bill pay switches for a specific customer identified by CUST-100045. It provides information on whether bill pay features are enabled or disabled for the customer.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the bill pay switches for the specified customer ID (CUST-100045). It enables clients to access the necessary settings and configurations related to the bill pay functionality.

200.description: Successfully retrieved bill pay switches for the specified customer.
